items.title: WhatsApp Username Reservations Go Live – What Are the Security Concerns for 2 Billion Users
items.description: WhatsApp has begun allowing users to reserve usernames ahead of a broader feature launch planned for later this year, prompting a wave of questions about security, impersonation risk, and account linkage that security researchers should be tracking closely.
